status: 已按本轮用户确认，作为新工程视觉基线
intent: 以真实教具和当前操作为视觉主体，减少背景、文本、按钮之间的竞争。
hierarchy: 常驻层：房间位置、当前问题、核心教具、一个主要操作。
局部检视层：点击词元、标签或数值时，在对象旁出现可关闭的小浮窗。
回顾层：完成当前实验后才展开结论、记录和出版复核。
全局导航：小型进度与返回入口；完整房间选择、手册及成果在抽屉或弹层中打开。
appearance: 近俯视教具与场景共用材质、光照、透视，环境细节收在边缘。
主操作保持清晰和高对比，远景降低纹理对比并使用轻微虚化。
浮窗文字区接近不透明，边缘允许半透明；辅助控件闲置时减弱，聚焦后显现。
保持墨色文字、暖白纸面、胡桃木、少量黄铜，以青绿色集中标记主动作。
motionProposal: 局部检视窗拟采用约160–220ms的透明度、轻微位移与柔焦过渡。
背景虚化仅用于景深和检视态的次要对象；核心词元、输入与按钮不模糊。
键盘聚焦与鼠标悬停采用同样的显现规则；触屏点击展开，提供清楚的关闭入口。
减少动态时直接显示稳定终态。静态概念图只展示状态，不能证明动画或可用性已验收。

images.name: 01-议事厅-主操作态
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptional, production-minded desktop front-end concept screenshot for the Chinese interactive AI course “活字印书局”, room “议事厅”. It is an actual designed application viewport, 16:10 landscape, NOT a poster, NOT a scene illustration without controls, NOT a wireframe, no mockup device or browser chrome. Professional editorial typography, precise layout, very clear hierarchy, exquisite restrained craft.

Core interaction: select the word “苹果” in a sentence and observe which other tokens it attends to. The entire screen is organized around that one manipulation. Make the attention instrument visually dominant and immediately understandable.

Visual direction: an elegant contemporary museum learning installation inside a quiet Chinese letterpress workshop. Warm ivory, ink charcoal, smoked walnut, muted brass, and a single deep petrol teal interaction accent; tiny vermilion editorial mark. A soft amber task light pools on the instrument. Peripheral shelves, window frame and paper stacks are only low-contrast, softly defocused edge atmosphere. The central walnut reading table and thin brass inlaid circles are sharply rendered and occupy most of the image. UI and world share the SAME materials, light and perspective. Mostly near top-down, gentle perspective, no dramatic room vista. Generous breathing room, no heavy ornament, no gradients on every button, no giant gold top tabs.

Composition:
- At the extreme top a very light, minimal header: left “‹ 活字印书局”, small breadcrumb “议事厅”; near center five tiny progress dots; right a quiet book icon labelled “手记” and settings icon. No horizontal wall of large navigation buttons.
- Upper left, directly on calm negative space, a small eyebrow “12 / 25” then an elegant legible large heading “「苹果」正在关注谁？” One short instruction below: “点一块活字，看看它在听谁。”
- Upper center a slim ivory paper sentence strip, not a giant panel: “小明用苹果拍了一张照片。” The word 苹果 subtly highlighted teal. A small “换一句” control at its right edge. The strip preserves the sentence order.
- Main visual at screen center, roughly x=28%-76%, y=31%-79%: a tactile attention instrument built into the wood table. A substantial pale metal “苹果” movable-type block is the clear focal point near the lower center of a thin circular brass inlay. Around it a spacious fan of six smaller movable-type blocks labelled “小明”, “用”, “拍”, “了”, “一张”, “照片”. Connect from 苹果 to the fan with finely crafted teal threads of different widths. The connection to 拍 is noticeably strongest; the others are elegant and faint. Do not cover the instrument with panels, charts or many numbers. Show just one very small local “25%” tag beside the strongest thread; other weights are hidden until requested. Refined contact shadows, precise crisp Chinese type on the blocks.
- Lower center a slim floating control dock, 460px wide relative to a 1600px viewport, at table edge: a two-option sentence switch “拍照的苹果” / “吃的苹果”, with the former active. Only ONE solid teal primary button “换一句看看”. Do not duplicate that primary button elsewhere.
- Bottom left a tiny collapsed guide icon, labelled “老师傅”, and bottom right two quiet compact tabs “看计算” and “本节发现”. Closed, no paragraph body.
- No persistent sidebar, no checklists, no large data table, no list of chapters, no full-height rectangular panels.

Polish: layered depth with peripheral opacity around 25–40%, inactive lines ghosted while still perceptible, active token fully crisp, softly frosted warm translucent surfaces only for small overlays, never low-contrast text. Typography mostly ink on ivory, minimum visually readable UI text. Show a settled interactive state, not motion trails. The whole composition should feel calm, distinctive, inviting, and usable by a young teenager. Include ONLY the specified Chinese UI copy.

iterations.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE polished desktop application concept screenshot, 16:10 landscape, for the Chinese interactive course “活字印书局”. Design an exquisite coherent interface inside a contemporary Chinese letterpress museum workshop. Warm ivory paper, smoked walnut, subtle brass, ink black, deep petrol teal active controls, restrained vermilion editorial details. Near top-down or shallow desk perspective, soft amber task light, sharp central teaching object, dim low-contrast softly defocused peripheral environment. Photographic material fidelity with crafted illustrative refinement. UI belongs to the physical workbench; it is not cards pasted over a busy wallpaper. Editorial Chinese serif headings, crisp comfortable sans-serif UI, generous negative space. Tiny translucent top navigation “‹ 活字印书局” plus room name, five small progress dots, right “手记” and settings icon. No giant navigation tabs. One clear visual subject, one short question, one strong primary action. No permanent sidebar, no checklist, no dense long paragraph, no grids of generic dashboard cards. Thin frosted warm surfaces only where needed, high text contrast. A real usable product screenshot, not a poster, no annotations outside the viewport or device mockup. Room “铸字房”. Main learning operation: enter one sentence and compare character/word/token splitting. Center the entire design on a single hands-on typesetting rail occupying 65% of the screen, NOT three stacked permanent rows. Header small progress “01 / 25”. Upper-left editorial question “一句话，怎样变成活字？” with short instruction “写一句话，再换一种拆法。”
The workshop background is only a quiet blurred edge: a hint of a type drawer and a lamp. The focal surface is a large angled walnut typesetting desk with a warm pool of light. At its upper middle, a long cream input paper ribbon contains the exact sentence “我的苹果屏幕摔裂了。” with a subtle caret and a small pencil icon, visually editable.
At center, huge readable tactile pale metal type blocks sit in a single slim brass-lined wooden composing rail, in order: “我”, “的”, “苹果”, “屏幕”, “摔裂”, “了”, “。” . 苹果 and 屏幕 are subtle fresh warm gold; others lead gray. The rail is physically built into the desk, spacious blocks and believable aligned contact shadows. A small unobtrusive badge at its end “7 块”. Selected 苹果 lifts slightly with a restrained teal edge.
Bottom-center floating ivory control dock: a three-way segmented mode control “按字 / 按词 / 字字”, 字字 active teal; a single solid teal primary button “拆开看看”. Secondary button “并排比较” is a quiet outlined text control, not another bright CTA.
At lower-left desk edge, a mostly closed type drawer with a small handle/tab labelled “字架”, no inventory list. At lower-right a single folded paper tab “本节发现”. Tiny collapsed “老师傅” icon in lower-left screen margin.
Use clean ivory negative space near heading, low texture contrast behind text, physically quiet scene edges. Make it immediately obvious that the sentence ribbon is the input and the large line of type blocks is the main output/interaction. No paragraph cards, no decorative slogans, no big character portrait.

A faint warm lamp, abacus silhouette and ink bowl exist only as blurred edge context; the four vessels remain sharp and bright.
